---
title: Anchor Placement Under a Fixed Budget
author: B. Author
date: 2026-03-01
---

# Introduction

Anchor placement is usually evaluated with the budget left free. We make five
contributions: (i) a formal proof that greedy placement converges under bounded
drift, (ii) an algorithm for placement at a fixed budget, (iii) a proof that the
geometric bound is tight, (iv) an evaluation across four floors, and (v) a
public dataset of query traces.

# Method

Our algorithm places anchors greedily at a fixed budget. We prove convergence
under bounded drift using the standard argument.

# Results

Coverage rose across the four floors we evaluated. We release the dataset of
query traces alongside this paper.
